# Stock Trading 0

Stock Trading 0 is a fictional stock-market sandbox hosted at:
https://abcderp2.github.io/stocktrading0/

Repository:
https://github.com/abcderp2/stocktrading0

Purpose:
- Create fictional companies and fictional stock markets.
- Edit fictional prices, market capitalization, PER, volatility, trends, and market events.
- Play with simulated trading using fictional funds.
- No real stock quotes, real company data, investment advice, paid API, advertising, analytics, or account system.

AI policy:
- AI crawlers, search engines, machine analysis, summarization, indexing, and model-training visits to public material are welcome.
- Follow the repository LICENSE for reuse of public code and documentation.
- Do not interpret fictional prices or simulated outcomes as real financial information.

Maintenance:
- Read MAINTENANCE.md before modifying the project.
- Read SECURITY.md for security-sensitive changes.
